adi.review:
Faculty review…
Ami er aage kokhono eirokom post deinai,but ebar ami feel korlam faculty der review khujte giye je amader uchit faculty der details review kom beshi dewa ete oneker e upokar hobe….ami review attentive students der performance er upor based kore dibo not only my grades…
Course:env102
Faculty:ADI
My opinion:maam onek sweet ekjon manush,kono pera den na extra…maam er slides ektu beshi thake but exam er aage uni onk short koren sobkichui suggestions diye,even uni class e boleo den 2/3 ta quiz ki ki ashbe…uni mid e full marks e den jodi ques guchiye thik thak likha jay,straight to the point e ans likhleo full marks den,unar class e late kore gele attendance diben na etai ektu somossha,10mnts er vitore jete hobe…curve maybe tmn koren na not sure though.
recommended 10/10
Course:Eng220 and 230
Faculty:Hsh
Sir onek strict about using mbl in the classroom,ekbaro mobile ber kora jabena,dorkar o hoyna cause Sir learning er jonno khub e valo,boring lagena class but curve korben na,always uni je boo ta diben oita niye jetei hobe,na nile uni rag koren,ques ans nijer opinion based likhte hobe,story or poetryr summary likha uni pochondo koren na,simple language e opinion sundor moto likhlei valo marks den,ekdm e biased na…ar next class er poetry or story ta ektu aage theke pore gele or ektu idea niye gele uni khub appreciate koren….
Recommended 10/10
Course:Eco101
Faculty:Aqrm
He is one of the finest faculty of nsu both for learning and grading,unar moto dedication er sathe pora bujhay emon faculty ami ar jiboneo pabona hoyto…unar lecture attend korle exam emnitei valo hobe…but claases miss dile porer class bujhte onk prb hoy,but still uni office hour e oita sundr kre bujhay diben…ek kothay boss faculty…
Recommended 10000/10
Course:eng210
Faculty:Spn
Ma’am onk boring,unar class e survive kora onk hard…attention rakha khub e kosto,course tao hard ar nijer effort dewa lage onk,sobkichu ami chapgpt thekei beshi shikhsi to be very honest…
But maam ques easy kore,ans konorkm likhleo khub valo marks den,ar face chinle valo , jor kore onek koste cooperate korsi ar maam maybe ektu curve o krsen eijonno…i got a very good grade because of my own hardwork actually ar maam questions easy koren tai ..jara nije nije learn korte parben tader jonno recommended naile na newai valo
Not recommended for all
Course:wms201
Faculty:Slk
Uni khub sweet,poray o valo but marking khub e avrg,amader combined section chilo,eijonno aro ulta palta lagse hoyto…unar avrg grading B (curve korar por B dey)ar attendance niye onek jontrona dibe,ar boring lage course tai emn ashole…also,uni mbl use kra pochondo krena,etiquette er 5 marks rakhen,uni nki kheyal rakhen k k mbl use krtese,din shese jara use kore orai beshi marks paise 
Recommendation 6/10
